deepseek41flash.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on Strix Halo: DSpark drafting, vision, tool calls and SSD expert streaming

releases.notes: Security fix in the GGUF loader (crafted table counts could overflow the tensor table). Expert streaming runs on Gufo's expert store (gufo-org/gufo#1318). Control-token spellings in request text stay text. Faster decode; --prefill-batch is removed. Built on Gufo 60c48924.

Extension API 0.3: prompts that arrive while another session decodes prefill one batch per pass (2048 tokens, following --prefill-batch), 36% faster with less total stall for the decoding session; prompt-cache restores and DSpark checkpoints wait for queued device writes. Built on Gufo a27bbf98 (after 0.34.0, included in 0.35.0).

Direction and LoRA adapters (--adapter, --adapter-scale); faster prefill and streamed decode, with more expert cache on streamed builds; --prefill-batch 4096 keeps the prompt cache and gives the same logits as 2048. Built on Gufo 0.33.0.

diffusion_gemma.description: DiffusionGemma 26B-A4B block-diffusion text model on Strix Halo: batched denoising, continuation cache, tool calls and reasoning

releases.notes: First registry release. Built on Gufo 0.35.0. Run on the GPU on Windows (Radeon 8060S); Linux builds and passes the CPU tests but has not run on a GPU.

flint.description: Flint 40B MoE text generation with optional DFlash2 speculative decoding

releases.notes: Native tool calls (OpenAI tools/tool_choice, flint-glm dialect, buffered and streamed) and a per-layer row continuation cache: each layer's K/V is append rows, so a capture copies only the valid tokens and a follow-up turn only the new tail; per-session memory is unchanged from 0.3.1. Prefill is split-invariant with even-row checkpoints; the drafter attends to history injected after a restore (8k repeat 41.5 -> 54.0 t/s, follow-up 43.5 -> 68.6); the GGUF mapping is released after upload (load RSS 26.3 -> 2.4 GB). Cache identity is flint-rocm-session-v2/flint-kv-rows-v2, so 0.3.1 disk caches are a miss by design. Greedy output is deterministic per build and spec-on equals spec-off; output can differ from 0.3.1 because prefill now runs every pass on the prefill kernels and the K-quant WMMA dot uses explicit FMAs. The 8 GiB retained-snapshot cap is unchanged. Built and validated on Gufo v0.36.0 (API 0.3.42); source builds on any 0.3.x host. At 262144 tokens, one session loads in ~10 s and two are admitted.

Long-context first-request stall fix: the retained-snapshot claim is capped at 8 GiB, so a full-context snapshot that the host would capture synchronously on the request thread (~15.7 GiB at -c 130000) is refused cheaply instead of copied. First request at 130k context: 14.2 s -> 0.47 s; prefix retention at normal contexts is preserved (8k: cached_tokens reused). No functional change to speculation, sampling or the DFlash2 cycle; gx 3/3 and memory 2/2 re-verified.

DFlash2 speculative decoding: opt-in draft/verify cycle with the Flint-DFlash2 drafter (--speculative dflash2 --dflash-model <gguf>; drafter must be passed explicitly), fixed and adaptive draft policies (adaptive default), byte-identical greedy output vs spec-off at depths 0/8k/32k/131k, no spec-off regression, prefix-reuse safe in serve, per-session drafter contexts (concurrency-safe), honest per-session ResourceClaim (scratch + MMQ arena + KV granule rounding). Provider exposes speculative_defaults (dflash2, max 7, min 1, adaptive). Ported to extension API 0.3 (required TextSchedulingProfile: pass_tokens 8192). Verified serve context ceiling 192k (256k startup hang is pre-existing, see DEFERRED). Built and validated on Gufo main 390639b3 (API 0.3.27, v0.35.0+).

Session contexts are sized to the request (prompt + generation) instead of a hardcoded 8192, clamped to the model's 262144 native context and to free device memory, so long contexts degrade gracefully instead of failing.
Weight placement fix: decide kMalloc vs managed once per model load (Flash-Next pattern) instead of a bare hipMalloc per tensor, so machines with a small device-heap cap load successfully.

gemma4.description: Gemma 4 31B, 31B QAT and 26B-A4B on Strix Halo: MTP drafting, vision, tool calls and reasoning

releases.notes: First registry release. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.

hy4flash.description: Tencent Hy4 Flash on Strix Halo: DFly2 drafting, vision, tool calls and reasoning

releases.notes: Hy4 Flash (hy_v4_flash) on gfx1151: chat, reasoning, tool calls, image input, prompt cache and Tencent's DFly2 drafter; loads the Xylolabs and AngelSlim Q4_K_M GGUFs. Built on Gufo abebd1c0.

lfm3.description: LFM3 1.7B text, LFM3-VL 2B, LFM3-Audio 2B and d1-Omni 2B on Strix Halo

releases.notes: Open WebUI realtime voice calls: conversations list their voice (female, the only one replies speak) and delete rejected user turns. Needs Gufo with extension API 0.3.50 (conversation turn transcripts).
Fixes SharePool most-vexing-parse bug and transposes short-convolution weights for SIMD in the NPU backbone (+13% to +19% NPU prefill across LFM3 models, exact GPU/NPU parity).
Adds pinned, locked install recipes for LFM3-1.7B, LFM3-VL-2B, LFM3-Audio-2B (shared ASR/TTS) and d1-Omni-2B, enabling gufo model install and NixOS model sync. Runtime code is unchanged from 0.6.0.
Adds XDNA NPU support via --npu, Windows support, shared audio decoding and text, vision, audio and decision performance improvements.
Text, VL, audio (ASR/TTS) and decision providers.

nemotron.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B on Strix Halo: LiLiCorr drafting, image input and Gufo's continuation cache
nemotron.license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND LicenseRef-OpenMDW-1.1

releases.notes: Gufo drops the separator after a prompt that closed reasoning (extension API 0.3.11); `gufo model install nemotron-3.5-bolt` installs the tested trunk, LiLiCorr drafter and vision projector. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.

Text generation from NVIDIA's QAD GGUF with optional LiLiCorr drafter (DFlash2) and vision projector; batched decoding, prompt passes split into layer groups beside decoding sessions. Built on Gufo 0.34.0.

qwen38_flash_next_exl3.description: Qwen3.8 Flash-Next EXL3 4.05, 3.05 and 2.05 bpw checkpoints on Strix Halo with MTP speculative decoding

releases.notes: Faster decode GEMV (Wht128Signed + HalfPairScaled + vectorized staging/output) and prefill GEMM (permlanex16 without redundant copy) with bit-identical outputs across 2/3/4 bpw. Needs Gufo 831c55d3 or later; Linux only.
Same production code as 0.1.1; the ops test now uses its own SwiGLU kernel instead of a private Gufo header. Needs Gufo 831c55d3 or later; Linux only.

First release: EXL3 providers flash-next-exl3-4bpw, -3bpw and -2bpw (HIP, gfx1151) with checkpoint MTP drafting, built on Gufo's in-tree qwen38_flash_next runtime. Needs Gufo 831c55d3 or later (loadable modules with depends, gufo-org/gufo#1376); Linux only.

qwen38_flash_next_flavors.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (qwen4exp) containers on Strix Halo that gufo core rejects: pruned 256-expert coder builds and 512-expert requantizations, IQ1_M through Q5_1, with the per-layer n-gram table served from disk

releases.notes: First registry release, as qwen38_flash_next_flavors. Installs as a module against a released gufo 0.3.37, no core patch. Serves the ISTA GSQ-RCO Coder IQ1_M (256 experts, IQ4_NL n-gram table), AtomicChat AD-4.27bpw-Q4_K_M-M64 (512 experts, three shards, Q5_1 table) and the Swift 1.5 GSQ-RCO IQ3_S re-quantization. Measured on gfx1151 with 128 GiB unified memory.

strycast_qwen35moe.description: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Ornith 1.5 122B on Strix Halo with MTP and DFlash2 speculative decoding

releases.notes: Builds against Gufo 0.33.0. Strycast's 35B-A3B and Ornith runner on the v0.33.0 base: Gufo's own KV-cache option, MTP prime chunk and layered prefill replace Strycast's earlier variants; the probe declines GGUFs whose expert formats the kernels cannot decode.

upscale.description: Real-ESRGAN x2/x4 image upscaling (SRVGGNetCompact) on Strix Halo with HIP

releases.notes: First release: Real-ESRGAN SRVGGNetCompact (realesr-animevideov3, realesr-general-x4v3, realesr-general-wdn-x4v3) as an image_generation provider for /v1/images/edits, x2 and x4. GPU-validated on Strix Halo (Windows) against Gufo main 0d238d4f; bit-identical to the in-tree upscaler of gufo-studio-windows. Video upscaling is not included yet.

voxcpm.description: OpenBMB VoxCPM2 on Strix Halo: multilingual 48 kHz speech synthesis with voice design and voice cloning

releases.notes: Declares two GPU hardware queues (extension API 0.3.24), so `gufo serve tts` decodes audio beside generation without `GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES`: 4 to 5 % faster with the Q8_0 file, 3 to 4 % with bfloat16 weights; cloning without a transcript (a preset without one, or `voice_clone_mode: speaker_embedding_only`) works instead of failing with 500. Built on Gufo 0.37.0.
`gufo model install voxcpm2` or `voxcpm2-q8` installs the tested Hugging Face weights or audio.cpp's Q8_0 GGUF (Gufo 0.35.0 or later); synthesis unchanged from 0.1.0. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.
Speech synthesis from the Hugging Face directory or audio.cpp's GGUFs (Q8_0 products on the matrix cores): automatic voice, voice design and voice cloning. Built on Gufo 0.34.0.
